note: Every difference the automated checks list was checked against the official episode file. For each subtitle difference the same moment of the episode audio was transcribed again in short focused windows with two further models (Whisper large-v3 and small.en, beam search and greedy) and the waveform was inspected at 10 ms resolution; a word is shown in the subtitles when the focused passes agree it is spoken. Edit points were placed by reading the waveform at 10 ms resolution. The contact sheets were inspected frame by frame.

subtitle_diffs.verdict: Not spoken twice. Focused large-v3 and small.en passes over 43:46.5-43:49.8 of the episode hear a single "right?"; the second "Right." only appears in the full-clip pass, at the cut.
"and" spoken unstressed ("an' especially", "an' Australian-operated"); the sentence needs "and".
The speaker restarts the word ("an Australian, Australian-built"); the repeated word is left out, as for other false starts.

edit_points.verdict: No pause between "that's exactly right" and "We're on Redbelly"; the edit is at the quietest point between the two words and the clip starts on "We're".
